annotations.title: Appeal rights, steps and free help for a plan type and state

description: Appeal My Claim. Appeal rights, steps and free help for a plan type and state. For requests like "what are my appeal rights in California?", "my insurer denied my claim, what can I do?" or "how do Medicare appeals work?". Returns who decides, the steps (internal appeal, external review, Medicare levels or Medicaid fair hearing), deadlines, and where to get free help, including the state insurance department. If the plan type is not known, leave it out to get the rules for most private plans.

plan_type.description: Plan type: marketplace, employer, employer_insured, employer_self_funded, medicare, medicare_advantage, part_d or medicaid. Everyday words work too, like "job", "Obamacare" or "Medi-Cal". Default: most private plans.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, like California or CA. Puerto Rico works too.
